<thought>To generate the precursors for the amide formation, we replace the amide bond in the target molecule with the corresponding carboxylic acid and separate the amine component. The target SMILES is Cc1ccc(NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(/C=C/C(=O)Nc3ccccc3N)cc2)cc1. Replacing the C(=O)N fragment with C(=O)O gives the acid precursor, and the amine fragment corresponds to an aniline. Thus the precursor pair is:
1. Cc1ccc(NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(/C=C/C(=O)O)cc2)cc1
2. c1ccccc1N</thought>
<final_answer>[[\"Cc1ccc(NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(/C=C/C(=O)O)cc2)cc1\", \"c1ccccc1N\"]]</final_answer>
